text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — we've published an updated Office Guest & Visitor policy (effective next Monday). Please read and complete the short compliance mini-training by end of next week. Link: https://redwood.example.com/guest-policy-training :spiral_note_pad:
Omar (Eng): thanks — is this required for everyone who brings vendors on site or just office hosts?
Maya (People Ops): Everyone who will be on-site and/or hosting guests at any Redwood location. Hosts must also complete the host checklist form.
Jess (Office Ops): host checklist link: https://redwood.example.com/host-checklist — we'll need to check badges and escorts for external vendors.
Liu (Recruiting): Quick Q: Are interview panelists who join in-person also required to do the training?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — in-person interviewers count as hosts/attendees. We added a ~6min module specifically for interview scenarios.
Omar (Eng): can managers opt to enroll whole teams? might save a bunch of manual reminders.
Maya (People Ops): Good idea — we added a manager bulk-ack option. Managers can submit the team CSV at this form: https://redwood.example.com/bulk-ack
HR Bot: Reminder set — people-ops will run a completion export every Friday at 16:00 PT.
Jess (Office Ops): I'll need the export to generate visitor stickers and room reservations. Can you add a column for "expected guests" in the export?
Maya (People Ops): yep — we'll add expected_guest_count and host_name columns to the weekly CSV.
Liu (Recruiting): Is there an accommodation path for folks who can't complete the training before their onsite day?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — temporary exemptions possible if the host notifies us 48h ahead. Use this form: https://redwood.example.com/exemptions — approvals get logged in the training tracker.
Omar (Eng): can you paste a short snippet of the host checklist we should follow?
Jess (Office Ops): sure — paste from checklist:
```
Host checklist (high level):
- Confirm guest identity + company
- Book badge + escort if non-employee
- Verify space reservation and AV
- Share safety & privacy slip with guest
```
Maya (People Ops): We're also rolling out a small change in the handbook section: "Visitors & Confidential Data" — it clarifies that guests should never be given access to sensitive projects without a signed NDA and approval. We'll push an update to the handbook page and note the change in the training module.
Omar (Eng): got it. will our Dedicated and Private infra teams need anything extra for vendor access?
Maya (People Ops): No special extra steps from ops side but security will audit access requests. We'll coordinate with eng-security on temporary creds.
HR Bot: Export complete (ts: 1791203810) — 142 total required, 98 completed, 6 exemptions approved, 38 pending. CSV: https://redwood.example.com/exports/1791203810.csv
Liu (Recruiting): thanks. I'll chase down interviewers who are pending.
Maya (People Ops): I'll send a reminder nudge tomorrow morning for anyone pending >72 hours. Please @mention me if a guest requires immediate exception. :thumbsup:
